Ratish Sharma

San Francisco Bay Area, USA (Ready to relocate) · (650) 472-7658 · ratee.beest@gmail.com

I am an Electrical and Computer Engineer with hands-on experience in RF, SAR, and OTA testing for wireless devices, currently working as an Associate Testing Technician at Element Materials Technology in the San Francisco Bay Area. My background combines practical laboratory testing, regulatory compliance, and engineering problem-solving in fast-paced environments.

I have worked extensively with RF test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers, and SAR measurement systems to evaluate device performance metrics including TRP, TIS, and RF exposure in accordance with FCC and industry standards. My role involves executing precise test procedures, analyzing results, and producing detailed technical reports to support regulatory submissions.

In addition to RF testing, I have a strong foundation in embedded systems and software, with experience in C, Embedded C, and Python. I have applied these skills to automate test workflows, process measurement data, and support hardware–software integration projects using platforms such as STM32 and Raspberry Pi.

My academic projects reflect my interest in applied engineering and system integration, ranging from a multimodal real-time emotion recognition system that received a college research award, to an autonomous model vehicle involving computer vision and sensor fusion. These projects strengthened my ability to work effectively in team-based environments and deliver reliable, real-world engineering solutions.

I am detail-oriented, quick to learn new tools and standards, and motivated to grow in roles focused on RF testing, wireless compliance, and hardware integration. This portfolio highlights my technical experience, projects, and continuous learning as I advance my career in wireless and embedded systems engineering.
